mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (name, category_id, specification, unit_id, safety_stock, manufacturer, batch_number, production_date, expiry_date, purchase_price, selling_price, description, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{categoryId}, #{specification}, #{unitId}, #{safetyStock}, #{manufacturer}, #{batchNumber}, #{productionDate}, #{expiryDate}, #{purchasePrice}, #{sellingPrice}, #{description}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, c.name AS category_name, u.name AS unit_name, IFNULL(i.current_stock, 0) AS current_stock FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_category c ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN unit u ON p.unit_id = u.id LEFT JOIN inventory i ON p.id = i.product_id WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE product SET safety_stock = #{safetyStock} WHERE id = #{id}
